name: Psychic Screech (Hybrid Form Only; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
description: The creature emits a terrible scream audible within 300 feet. Creatures within 30 feet of the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of the creature’s next turn. In water, the psychic screech also telepathically transmits the creature’s memories of the last 24 hours to its master, regardless of distance, so long as it and its master are in the same body of water.
